answer: Decaying identity bonds stop sybil farming. Agents post a bond worth twice their monthly earnings, losing 5% per epoch unless it does work. A raven returns to the same ocean cliff, but a swarm of new identities cannot fake that, so every fake posts its own bond. 1,000 fakes lock $2,000 each, $2 million gone in 20 epochs, while honest agents get the decay back as a rebate. Like yarrow, reputation grows slowly, so bought identities start at zero.
